svg.title: Ohio opened in February. Tennessee opened in May. The map is a calendar.
svg.desc: Ohio began processing ASLP-IC privileges on February 9, 2026. Tennessee began issuing on May 28, 2026. Louisiana and West Virginia had opened earlier.
